dedupe_keys.name: the skyscraper center database of tall buildings worldwide with official heights council on vertical urbanism formerly ctbuh

description: The Skyscraper Center is an interactive database from the Council on Vertical Urbanism that indexes millions of data points on thousands of skyscrapers around the world and presents the council's official information on them. Users can look up detailed information on individual buildings, create custom lists, graphs and maps, and browse the tallest structures by city, country, region, function, material and other attributes; the council publishes its criteria and standards for determining official building heights and rankings. Coverage: tall buildings worldwide; individual building pages were not opened. Format and access: interactive web pages; basic browsing is free; whether full data export requires membership was not read. Licence: not read; the data belong to the council. Caveats: the register lists the owner as the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat, and the site now names the Council on Vertical Urbanism, so the change of name is noted but was not read about; coverage concentrates on tall buildings and does not describe ordinary building stock. Simulation uses: height, structure material and function of tall buildings for wind, earthquake and fire exposure studies and for vertical evacuation and telecom siting in dense city centres. Related records: none linked yet; city 3D building models give geometry for ordinary building stock.
